items.q: How much does a website cost with GotFound?
items.a: The professional website costs %PRICE% one-time, with domain and hosting included for the first year. Extras like an online store, booking or extra languages are quoted in writing before we start.

items.q: Do I have to pay anything upfront?
items.a: No. You get a free draft within 48 hours and only pay once you like the website and approve it.

items.q: What happens after the first year?
items.a: From the second year, the domain and hosting renew. We tell you the cost clearly in advance, and you're free to move them elsewhere.
The draft arrives within 48 hours of your first message. After you approve it, the site usually goes live within a few days, depending on the changes you ask for.

items.q: Is the domain registered to me?
items.a: Yes. The domain belongs to your business. If you ever switch providers, it goes with you.

items.q: Do you work with businesses anywhere in the US?
items.a: Yes. We work remotely, by WhatsApp and email, with local businesses in any state.

items.q: Can I update the site after it's live?
items.a: Of course. Small updates like hours or a menu change are quick; bigger changes are quoted first.

items.q: Will the site work well on phones?
items.a: Yes. Every site is designed for smartphones first, because that's where most local customers find you.
